passage: During Class 6 morning break, I watched Deepak wave at Mahima as she crossed the corridor. She kept walking, head down, holding her books. Deepak's hand fell. He sat down heavily on the bench and said to me, “She didn't even look.” I didn't know what to say. Later, I saw Mahima at the water stand with her eyes red, maybe because of a headache or worry about the test. I don't know. When she came back, Deepak said, “Hi,” and she smiled and answered. Deepak grinned and looked embarrassed at once. “I guess she just didn't see me,” he told me.

qa.q: Who waved at Mahima in the corridor?
How did Deepak feel when Mahima did not respond to his wave, and what did he later conclude?
qa.a: He felt hurt and snubbed, but after she smiled and replied later, he thought she might simply not have seen him.

qa.q: What could Deepak do next time someone ignores his hello?
qa.a: He could check again later, as he did, before deciding it means unfriendliness.

qa.q: How might Mahima have been feeling when she passed the corridor?
qa.a: She may have been worried or unwell, since her eyes were red later, so she was probably busy with her own thoughts.

grounding: A missed hello may be inattention rather than snub, and checking twice before feeling hurt is wise.

passage:
Monday. Avni gave a big smile to the new boy Jomon at the gate, but he looked past her. Avni went quiet all morning, thinking he didn't like her.

Wednesday. She said hello again in the corridor. Jomon jumped, took out earphones and said, “Oh, sorry, I was listening to a story!” Avni laughed, a bit surprised.

Friday. Jomon waved to her from far away at the canteen, and Avni waved back. “I thought you ignored me,” she told him. “I did not see you on Monday,” he said. “I'm still learning where everyone is.”

qa.q: What was Jomon doing on Wednesday when Avni said hello again?
qa.a: He was listening to a story with earphones.

qa.q: What did Avni first think when Jomon looked past her at the gate?
qa.a: She thought he did not like her and felt hurt, so she stayed quiet all morning.

qa.q: What did Avni do that helped her read the situation better?
qa.a: She said hello again on Wednesday instead of deciding on Monday that he was cold.

qa.q: How might Jomon have felt as a new boy on the first days?
qa.a: He was probably busy learning where everyone is, so he missed the smile without meaning to be unfriendly. 🙂

grounding: A missed hello may be inattention, and a child checks twice before feeling hurt.
